runtimes.value: Ollama official gpt-oss:120b (65 GB, local); llama.cpp llama-server with GGUF (ggml-org, MXFP4); LM Studio (lmstudio-community GGUF and MLX-8bit); mlx-lm with mlx-community builds (MXFP4-Q8, MXFP4-Q4, 4bit); vllm-mlx has a gpt_oss/harmony parser. Needs the harmony chat format, handled by these runtimes
runtimes.note: Open runtime issues for gpt-oss on Mac were not searched. vllm-mlx support is inferred from its parser modules, not from a supported-models list.

web.scope: Released in August 2025, so more than 12 months old: comments from the last 6 months only (since 13.05.2026). Searched on 13.11.2026: Hacker News comments (Algolia API); 98 matching comments, the relevant ones below. r/LocalLLaMA and Hugging Face discussions not read yet.
web.summary: Good for its time, but by late 2026 users find it weaker than Qwen3.8-27B, especially for code and tool use.

comments.text: Outperformed by newer, smaller models: most recent 27B models beat it ([Art9681, 25.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49436170)); Qwen3.8 27B is clearly better at coding ([kennywinker, 12.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49676994)); only 5B active parameters and ≈ 13 months older than Qwen3.8 ([ac29, 12.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49678007)).
Mediocre results and clear underperformance in one user's own evaluations ([shard972, 24.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49825770)).
Prone to overthinking: 3–10k tokens of reasoning per turn ([nostrebored, 03.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49556894)).

Tool calls announced but never made, thinking blocks never closed, loops ([LoganDark, 19.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49359217), [24.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49829591)). Caveat: this was on Cerebras, a cloud provider; it may not apply to Ollama.

Still very useful ([0xbadcafebee, 19.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49362704)); close to the frontier when it was released ([Philpax, 28.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49481096)).
Answered a simple reasoning question correctly, like other models ([epihelix, 25.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49840038)).
Still chosen by a maker of 128 GB local-AI boxes as the larger model for harder tasks ([moezee1, 28.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49873613)).
